Özgün Ünlü hocanın öğrencilerle iletişimi oldukça güçlü. Özellikle quiz süreçlerinde öğrencilere çok yardımcı olması ve öğrenciyi zor durumda bırakmamaya çalışması oldukça olumlu bir öğrenme ortamı sağlıyor. Konular anlaşılmadığında birebir iletişim kurarak destek olması da dersin verimini artırıyor. Öğrenci odaklı yaklaşımı sayesinde sınıfta rahat bir atmosfer oluşuyor.

Strongest: Mr. Ünlü documentates the pictures of what he has wrote on the board during the lesson, which helped a lot while understanding the topic. I think the best part of it was this availability to what's done in the lesson. Actually, I want this for every course; it was so helpful. The other strong point is that while instructing a new topic, definition or method, his method of writing the definiton on the board and explaining it makes learning easier, more compact, both more comprehensive and consice. Instead of writing the same sentence over and over for each scenario, writing it for one time and filling in the blanks with a chart was useful for me to learn; especially in limits. Even though it took a bit time to get used to this method, it made sense at the end. A different strong point was that he did not copy-paste everything in the book or his notes, without explaining it. After writing the problem, it felt like we were heading to that answer together and he asked questions about the next step regularly; which make the lesson interesting and makes us think about it. If he did not asked questions along solving it, it would be like watching a video and would not help me learn.

Weakest: Sometimes, the time allocated for some quizzes were not enough to finish it. Thus the shortage of time made me panic a little and that led to some mistakes that I wouldn't have done if given a little more time. In midterms or finals, I do not have that panic so I get to think comprehensively and creatively, which get me to the right solution. I do not ask to have 30 minutes for a question that would take 15 minutes but a slightly better time allocation could've been done.
